label: D2 reaching S2 after an unrewarded rare a2->S1 trial, mid-episode, stronger when S2 believed good
short_terms: last_is("a2 S1 u") * (in_state == 2) * isin(ep_dec,[4,5,6,7]) ;; last_is("a2 S1 u") * (in_state == 2) * isin(ep_dec,[3,4,5,6,7]) ;; last_is("a2 S1 u") * (in_state == 2) * isin(ep_dec,[5,6,7])
terms: last_is("a2 S1 u") * (in_state == 2) ;; last_is("a2 S1 u") * (in_state == 2) * (action == 2) ;; last_is("a2 S1 u") * (in_state == 2) * (action==2) * (ep_trial > 20) ;; last_is("a2 S1 u") * (in_state == 2) * (action==2) * (ep_trial > 20) * (-belief_lo) ;; last_is("a2 S1 u") * (in_state == 2) * (action==2) * (ep_trial > 80) ;; last_is("a2 S1 u") * (in_state == 2) * (action==2) * (tv("reward",-2)==1) ;; last_is("a2 S1 u") * (in_state == 2) * (action==2) * (tv("action",-2)==2) ;; (in_state==2)*(action==2)*(ep_trial>20)*np.maximum(-belief_lo,0)
explanation: Sparse D2-only feature (nonzero on 1.2% of steps, silent at D1/GO). Its magnitude is carried by one previous-trial pattern: the last trial was a2 -> S1 (rare) unrewarded and the agent has now reached S2 (in practice a2 common, i.e. the agent stayed with a2 after a rare-unrewarded outcome, the model-based stay). Within that condition activation is large (~0.6-0.8) mainly mid-episode (deciles 2-7, peaking 3-6) and is suppressed early and in the last ~20 trials; it grows weakly with the ideal observer belief that S2 is good (-belief_lo). All other previous-trial patterns sit at about zero. The free fit (adding a2 choice, trial-before reward / choice, late-episode cutoffs) reaches the same test R^2 as the short form (0.472 vs 0.471), so the short form captures what the additive cues explain; residual misses are mostly window-first trials where the previous trial is outside the window and within-condition variation not captured by belief. No model outputs or future variables used.

issues: The core condition is correct. On test, last_is('a2 S1 u')*(in_state==2) alone scores 0.295. Splitting by choice (action==2 vs 1) changes nothing, and the profile residual is +0.14 only in this D2 cell, about 0 everywhere else.

The mid-episode window is in the wrong place. The label and short form put it at deciles 2-7, peaking at 3-6. A single term over deciles 3-6 scores only 0.400 on test. A single term over deciles 4-7 (trials 40-79) scores 0.573, which already beats the whole recorded 3-term form (0.471). Decile 7 matters a lot (deciles 3-6 give 0.400, deciles 3-7 give 0.525). Adding decile 8 hurts (deciles 3-8 give 0.459).

The 'stronger when S2 believed good' claim is close to negligible. Adding the -belief_lo term moves test R^2 from 0.467 to 0.471 in the recorded form, and from 0.573 to about 0.589 with the corrected window. Thresholded versions (belief_lo < 0, < -1, < -2) inside the condition give 0.297-0.303, against 0.295 for the bare condition.

Mid-episode activation is all-or-none. In misses, many in-condition windows in trials 40-79 are silent (actual 0, predicted 0.45) while others fire at about 0.7. No observed variable explains which ones fire. Each of these, added to the condition, gains at most 0.013: the choice, state, transition or reward two or three trials back, belief_cover, and belief thresholds.

The other remaining misses are first-of-window D2 cells where the previous trial lies outside the window. Their activation is about 0.7 but the prediction is about 0.03. This matches the original explanation.
